fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

official_name.value: Nova School of Business and Economics (Nova SBE)

min_standing_note.value: There is no minimum GPA required to join Nova SBE's Exchange Program; applicants must be officially nominated by a partner university through Nova SBE's online nomination platform and satisfy English proficiency requirements.
min_standing_note.notes: Online nomination platform requirement also confirmed in AY 2026/27 Fact Sheets (#page=2-3).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Mapped from Excel agreement_scope_raw 'Business and Economics' (Nova SBE is NOVA University Lisbon's Business & Economics school; note AUC also holds a cross-referenced partner entry for universidade-nova-de-lisboa).

excluded_majors.notes: No excluded majors listed in AY 2026/27 BSc or MSc Fact Sheets; enrollment in specific courses is via Bidding and not guaranteed.

min_gpa_host.notes: Official incoming exchange page (https://www.novasbe.unl.pt/en/programs/exchange-programs/incoming-exchange-students) explicitly states there is no minimum GPA required by Nova SBE.

instruction_languages.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=3
instruction_languages.notes: BSc Fact Sheet #page=3: course offer fully available in English (1st-year courses may also be taught in Portuguese); MSc Fact Sheet #page=3: programme only available in English.

english_course_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=3
english_course_availability.notes: BSc course offer fully available in English; MSc programme exclusively in English (MSc #page=3).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: One required: IELTS 6, TOEFL iBT 80 (online acceptable), Cambridge CFE >=170, CAE/CPE (any passing grade), proof that high school or current Bachelor's/Master's degree is fully taught in English, OR home-institution statement confirming CEFR B2 fluency. RHET 1020 not mentioned; AUC's English-medium current degree satisfies exemption.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=3
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Identical requirement in MSc Fact Sheet #page=3.

host_language_requirement.value: No Portuguese required for English-taught BSc/MSc exchange courses (optional Portuguese semester courses offered via NOVA FCSH per 2023-24/2021-22 Fact Sheets).
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=3

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026/27 Fall (S1): Course enrollments 14–16 Jul 2026 (BSc) / 21–23 Jul (MSc); Welcome Week 25–27 Aug (BSc) / 26–28 Aug (MSc); S1 Classes 31 Aug–4 Dec 2026 (1st-yr BSc starts 8 Sep; T1 31 Aug–12 Oct, T2 22 Oct–4 Dec); Exams: T1 14–20 Oct, S1/T2 7–21 Dec 2026; BSc resits 5–16 Jan 2027.
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=6
fall_term_dates.notes: MSc Fall dates also on MSc Fact Sheet #page=6.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026/27 Spring (S2): Course enrollments 5–7 Jan 2027 (BSc) / 18–20 Jan (MSc); Welcome Day 29 Jan 2027; S2 Classes 1 Feb–14 May 2027 (1st-yr BSc 2 Feb; T3 1 Feb–16 Mar, T4 5 Apr–14 May); Exams: T3 18–25 Mar, S2/T4 17 May–2 Jun 2027; BSc resits 14–23 Jun 2027.
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=6
spring_term_dates.notes: MSc Spring dates also on MSc Fact Sheet #page=6.

final_semester_allowed.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=5
final_semester_allowed.notes: Allowed with explicit warning: BSc & MSc Fact Sheets #page=5 state 'We do not guarantee enrollments in specific or first choice courses... Students who need to take specific courses and/or are in the last semester of their degree must be made aware of this rule before applying.'

tuition_model.notes: Bilateral/partner exchange students pay tuition at their home institution and are exempt from Nova SBE tuition (non-partner Freemovers pay Nova SBE tuition); all incoming students still pay the mandatory EUR 36.50 administrative/insurance fee (Fact Sheet #page=3).

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=5
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Identical monthly estimate on BSc & MSc Fact Sheets #page=5: Accommodation EUR 450–850 + Meals EUR 180–200 + Books/Supplies EUR 50 + Public Transport EUR 30–40 + Leisure EUR 80–150 = EUR 790–1,290/month.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=5
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD midpoint estimate derived from EUR 790–1,290/month range (midpoint EUR 1,040/mo x 5 = EUR 5,200) converted at ECB 2026-11-13 reference rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (collected 2026-11-15 via https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html): 5,200 x 1.1052 = 5,747.04 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: All incoming students (including exchange and Freemovers) must pay EUR 36.50 for Administrative Fees and School Insurance (non-waivable; NetPa documents/transcripts withheld until settled). Non-EU students without EHIC are encouraged to obtain full health insurance for their stay in Lisbon (#page=5). Grade improvement exam optional fee EUR 15 (BSc #page=4).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=3

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=5

housing_notes.value: Nova SBE has partnerships with external housing companies helping foreign students find accommodation in Lisbon or Carcavelos (see Life at Nova Guide: https://novasbe.maglr.com/life-at-nova-sbe-guide/accommodation).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=5

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Portuguese visa processing takes 2 weeks to 3 months; students must apply immediately upon receiving Acceptance Letter and must NOT enter on a Tourist Visa (cannot be renewed). School intervention in visa/residence permits is legally limited (#page=5). See Life at Nova Guide (https://novasbe.maglr.com/life-at-nova-sbe-guide/international-students) and Portuguese MFA visa forms (https://vistos.mne.gov.pt/en/short-stay-visas-schengen/general-information/application-forms).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=5

exchange_page_url.notes: Also linked in AY 2026/27 Fact Sheet #page=2 /Annots.

course_catalog_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=4
course_catalog_url.notes: Nova SBE notes Guia UNL descriptions may be outdated pre-acceptance (full syllabi posted on Moodle after acceptance). 2023-24 Fact Sheet also links https://www.novasbe.unl.pt/en/programs/exchange-programs/courses-for-exchange-students.

english_course_list_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=4
english_course_list_url.notes: Full BSc (except some 1st-yr PT options) and MSc curriculum taught in English; pre-acceptance catalogue on UNL Guia.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS (1 ECTS = 28 total workload hours). Semester courses (S1/S2, 12 weeks) = 7 ECTS; trimester short courses (T1–T4, 6 weeks) = 3.5 ECTS. Incoming load: no minimum ECTS required, maximum 31.5 ECTS/semester. Grading scale 0–20 (10 minimum pass).
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=4
credit_system_and_load.notes: Max 31.5 ECTS and no minimum stated on #page=5.

course_restrictions_note.value: All classes/exams strictly on campus at Carcavelos (Rua da Holanda, 1); midterms/exams/presentations may occur on Saturdays (#page=6). Enrollment is via points Bidding platform + Add/Drop; specific/first-choice courses not guaranteed (#page=5). Overlapping-exam courses cannot be taken simultaneously; BSc allows max 2 resits per semester (#page=4), MSc has 1 exam period per course (MSc #page=4).
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=5

value: Online nomination & application via http://apps.novasbe.pt/NovaMobility (instructions sent post-nomination)
English proficiency proof (IELTS 6, TOEFL iBT 80, CFE 170, CAE/CPE, full-English degree proof, or B2 home-school statement)
Learning Agreement (EWP for Erasmus or PDF A-Form for non-Erasmus)
required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=3

academic_style.value: Semester courses split into 2x 6-week trimesters (T1/T2 Fall, T3/T4 Spring) alongside full 12-week courses; mandatory >=50% in-class assessment weight and 30–70% exam weight; all classes/exams on Carcavelos coastal campus; Saturday exams possible.
academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=4

international_support_services.value: Welcome Week / Welcome Day orientation, Student Central walk-ins (Mon/Wed/Fri 10:00–13:00, #page=2), NetPa student portal, Library & Documentation Centers, study rooms, cafeterias/canteen, private medical facilities on campus, Santander Bank branch, Student Organizations & Clubs open to incoming students (#page=5).
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=5

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall & Full Year: Nominations 20 Feb–20 Apr, Applications 27 Apr; Spring: Nominations 20 Jul–20 Sep, Applications 27 Sep (online nomination platform only; email nominations not accepted).
nomination_deadlines.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nova School of Business and Economics/2026- 2027/Incoming BSc Factsheet_26_27.pdf#page=3
